$comment: The publishEvent request body schema of the AgentCat API: agentcat-server schema.yml at commit fba51c0, path paths./v1/public/events/.post.requestBody.content.application/json.schema, with each OpenAPI nullable written as a type list. Refresh it by hand when the API changes.

id.description: ID of the event, typically auto-generated by the AgentCat Agent

project_id.description: ID of the project this event belongs to

session_id.description: ID of the session this event belongs to. Null for stateless mode (server assigns session).

event_id.description: Optional custom event ID (must be unique)

is_error.description: Whether this event represents an error

error.description: Error details if is_error is true

resource_name.description: Name of the resource accessed (for resource events)

duration.description: Duration of the operation in milliseconds

input_tokens.description: Token count of the request side as measured by the SDK. When absent, the server estimates it from the stored parameters.

output_tokens.description: Token count of the response side as measured by the SDK. When absent, the server estimates it from the stored response. Drives the oversized-tool-response rule.

timestamp.description: Agent-provided timestamp of when the event occurred

user_intent.description: Captured explanation of why the actor made this request

tags.description: Custom string key-value pairs. Keys: max 32 chars, alphanumeric/underscore/period/colon/dash/dollar-sign only. Values: max 200 chars, no newlines. Max 50 entries.

properties.description: Custom structured data. Keys are strings, values can be string, number, boolean, array, object, or null (null values are filtered out).

sdk_language.description: Programming language of the SDK used

examples.user_intent: Calculate the sum of two numbers
